claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: The photos only show a boxed electronic keyboard/piano instrument with keys and control panel graphics on the box; brand/model and any sound/working status are not shown or readable.

risks.risk: Not tested/unknown functionality (keys, speakers, display, buttons may not work).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on and a full test: pressing keys across low/mid/high range, volume/speaker output, and any display/buttons responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested (worst-case) until a power-on test is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model and specifications unclear; could be a different make or lower-spec unit than implied.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (sticker) on the box and/or the unit, plus a photo of the control panel showing model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely spec for a generic boxed electronic keyboard until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Shipping/packaging damage or missing parts (keys, casing, internal components) hidden under wrap/tape.
risks.proof: Unboxing video showing the keyboard out of the box, checking for dents/cracks, and showing all included items laid out (adapter, stand, pedal, manual, cables).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/with possible damage until accessories and physical condition are verified.

risks.risk: Key condition issues (sticky keys, uneven feel, damaged keytops) not visible through the boxed front.
risks.proof: After unboxing: close-up of keytops and a quick demonstration of key responsiveness (rapid repeated presses) across multiple keys.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible key wear/damage until key responsiveness is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Age/usage history unknown; could be heavily used or previously repaired.
risks.proof: Photo of any service/repair stickers or internal inspection (if available) and a clear statement plus proof of last service date/receipt (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/unknown wear until usage history is provided.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the brand/model label on the box and on the keyboard (if visible).
Send a short video: power-on, display working, volume/speaker output, and keys responding across the keyboard.
Send an unboxing clip showing the keyboard out of the box and a checklist of included accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal, USB/cables, manual).
Send close-ups of the keytops and any visible damage (scratches/dents/cracks) after unboxing.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a boxed electronic keyboard, but the photos do not verify brand/model, working status, or included accessories. Without a power-on and unboxing proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
